description: NaY(SeO₃)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.54 Å. Y is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing YO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.51 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.70 Å) and two longer (1.71 Å) Se-O bond lengths. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.75 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Y, and one Se atom to form corner-sharing ONa₂YSe tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Y and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Y, and one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Y and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Y, and one Se atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Y, and one Se atom.
